name: hv16_dbk_cpl_o1b-o1b-COMMIT
purpose: HBM die d4g hb_dbk_<q> x4 (per quadrant, master unchanged; F20 tgt 104+QID: SW 104 / SE 105 / NW 106 / NE 107; RBH-STK). Measured reasons (hv15_dbk_cp gate 1f18141cb, 10-16): clk_cp 1,844 sinks TT 421.6 / spread 126.5 (collar flops smeared between the 8 banks), rst_n port -> 793 loads unregistered incl. 8 bank macros + controller (in->macro -296.1), in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26] with the W face 98% pin-full; children off the 43.2 um lattice; 645.84 x 360.72 (1.79:1).  Why not the d4f slot 560 x 400: on the 43.2 um child lattice three 87.48-um bank rows need y = 43.2/172.8/302.4 (top 389.9, no N channel left in 400) and three 140.4-um columns need x up to 529.2, so 560 x 400 holds at most 2 x 3 = 6 banks; 8 banks + controller + collar leaf = 10 objects, and every bank must stay within ~480 um of BOTH the W face (rr) and the N face (wd) (textbook wire_reach 500 um/stage).  A 3-row ring (controller centre) cannot take the leaf within 1.5:1 (width >= 712 at height 432).  Chosen: 4 rows x 3 columns, 604.8 x 540 (1.12:1):   * col0 (x 86.4, 4 banks; 86.4 um W channel carries their 1,156 wd bits N), col1/col2 (x 259.2/432) banks in rows 0     and 3; the controller in col1 between rows 1-2 (bank star <= ~430 um), the collar leaf in col2 between rows 1-2     (W face -> controller E face 104 um; E face 21.6 um from the cluster E face where the F20 host bus enters);   * channels >= 32.4 um (columns) / 42.1 um (rows), every child on the 43.2 lattice;   * W face: rr per bank row (rq + rr_valid beside the controller row), <= 4.6 pins/um; N face: wd per bank column + wb/wa,     <= 4.5 pins/um; each clk_bank entry on the face point nearest its bank clock pin; clk_cp at the leaf clock pin.

structural_change: HBM-DBK9 10-21 (H.STA.BLK.12): OUTPUT-LANDED successor after daemon route hv16_dbk_cpl_l1-l1-f5284ed97 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (post-CTS TT WNS -538.3 / 2,494 endpoints / TNS -689,018 at 833.333, IO paths judged at the IO reference). Classified: every failing endpoint is child macro -> parent OUTPUT port (fanout 1, no logic): controller wb_reserve_base -538.3 (arc 368.6 + 330 ps unbuffered port wire, slew 1,047), bank wd -525..-362 (arc 340-440 + wire 237-408 ps to the S/N faces), collar cp_configured -425.8, rq/mv_*/quiet/busy; inputs (+21..+91), macro->macro (+106..+211) and reset recovery (+454) all met. New master ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks_cplo: every output leaves from a kept face register on a regional root beside its face group (4 new die-forwarded entries clk_out[3:0] for the S/N wd + wb groups; rq on clk_land[3]; status + collar on clk_rst). Cycles handed to the die: every output +1 edge vs _cpl, rr lanes padded to RR_RT-2 = 78 (DIE_PRE 2). FALLBACK o1b (parallel, owner 10-19): same master/geometry/roots + a strong pin driver on every flop-driven output (out_pin_driver.tcl OT_OUT_DRV_ABSORB: the QN->INV of each face register becomes a dont_touch INVx8 at the port; l1 measured 1,047 ps slew on an unbuffered port wire), so the 2,600 output pins drive the die-side wire with a fixed strong cell; same stage count, 0 cycles.
